note: MCU Easter Eggs quiz. Every answer must be checkable in the named film (note says where). Add questions here; ids must stay unique. tiers: points per right answer; seconds = timer per question (0 = none). ranks: quiz rank by lifetime points (separate from the found-details rank).

tiers.name: Sidekick
tiers.blurb: The big names and moments. Seen the movies once? Start here.

tiers.name: Hero
tiers.blurb: Villains, places and plot points from across the Infinity Saga.

tiers.name: Avenger
tiers.blurb: Names, relics and twists that casual fans forget.

tiers.name: Inevitable
tiers.blurb: Thanos-level trivia: exact numbers, years and tiny details. 15 seconds a question.

shangchi.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)

questions.q: What is the name of Tony Stark's company?
questions.why: Tony runs Stark Industries, the weapons company his father Howard started.
questions.note: Opening act: Tony is presented as CEO of Stark Industries.

questions.q: Which actor plays Tony Stark?
questions.why: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark from Iron Man (2008) to Avengers: Endgame (2019).

questions.q: What are the last words Tony says at the press conference that ends Iron Man (2008)?
questions.why: He drops the cover story on the cards and tells the world he is Iron Man.

questions.q: What is the name of Tony Stark's AI assistant in his house?
questions.why: J.A.R.V.I.S. runs Tony's house and workshop and helps build the suits.

questions.q: What is the name of Thor's hammer?
questions.why: Odin enchants Mjolnir so only the worthy can lift it.
questions.note: Odin banishes Thor and sends Mjolnir to Earth.

questions.q: Who is Thor's adopted brother?
questions.why: Loki learns he is a Frost Giant child Odin took in as a baby.
questions.note: Loki confronts Odin in the weapons vault.

questions.q: What is the name of the realm Thor comes from?
questions.why: Thor is a prince of Asgard and Odin's son.

questions.q: What metal is Captain America's round shield made of?
questions.why: Howard Stark says vibranium is stronger than steel and a third of the weight.
questions.note: Howard shows Steve the shield in his lab.

questions.q: Who becomes Captain America?
questions.why: Steve Rogers takes the super-soldier serum in 1943 and becomes Captain America.

questions.q: Which city do the Chitauri attack at the end of The Avengers (2012)?
questions.why: Loki opens the portal over Stark Tower in Manhattan.

questions.q: What does Bruce Banner turn into when he gets angry?
questions.why: Banner's secret in The Avengers: "I'm always angry."
questions.note: Banner changes before the Chitauri leviathan.

questions.q: What is Natasha Romanoff's code name?
questions.why: Natasha Romanoff is the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent known as Black Widow.

questions.q: What is the only thing Groot says?
questions.why: Groot only says "I am Groot" (and once "We are Groot" at the end).

questions.q: What is Star-Lord's real name?
questions.why: Peter Quill was taken from Earth in 1988 by Yondu's Ravagers.

questions.q: What is Ant-Man's real name in Ant-Man (2015)?
questions.why: Hank Pym hands the suit to Scott Lang, a thief just out of prison.
questions.note: Scott takes the suit from Hank's house.

questions.q: What country is Black Panther king of?
questions.why: T'Challa becomes king of Wakanda after his father's death.

questions.q: What was Stephen Strange's job before he learned magic?
questions.why: Strange is a top neurosurgeon until a car crash ruins his hands.

questions.q: What is the name of Peter Parker's aunt?
questions.why: Aunt May raises Peter in Queens.

questions.q: How many Infinity Stones are there?
questions.why: Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time and Soul.

questions.q: Who snaps his fingers to wipe out half of all life in Avengers: Infinity War?
questions.why: Thanos snaps with the full Infinity Gauntlet in Wakanda.

questions.q: What color is the Tesseract, which holds the Space Stone?
questions.why: The Tesseract glows blue.
questions.note: Opening scene at the S.H.I.E.L.D. base.

questions.q: In what country is Tony Stark held captive in Iron Man (2008)?
questions.why: Tony is captured during a weapons demo in Afghanistan.

questions.q: Who is the main villain of Iron Man (2008)?
questions.why: Obadiah Stane, Tony's partner at Stark Industries, builds his own giant suit.
questions.note: Final fight on the Stark Industries roof.

questions.q: In Iron Man 2, what is slowly poisoning Tony Stark?
questions.a: The palladium core in his arc reactor
questions.why: The palladium in the reactor poisons his blood until he makes a new element.
questions.note: Blood toxicity readings throughout the film.

questions.q: In Iron Man 2, where does Ivan Vanko first attack Tony?
questions.a: At the Monaco Historic Grand Prix
questions.why: Vanko walks onto the race track with electric whips.

questions.q: What time of year is Iron Man 3 set?
questions.why: The film is set over Christmas, with a giant toy bunny gift for Pepper.

questions.q: What is the name of the Nazi science division led by the Red Skull?
questions.why: Red Skull runs Hydra and splits from the Nazis.

questions.q: Which scientist gives Steve Rogers the super-soldier serum?
questions.why: Erskine picks Steve for Project Rebirth and is shot right after it works.

questions.q: What is Hawkeye's real name?
questions.why: Clint Barton is the S.H.I.E.L.D. archer Loki takes over.
questions.note: Opening scene at the S.H.I.E.L.D. base.

questions.q: What Infinity Stone is inside Loki's scepter?
questions.why: Age of Ultron (2015) confirms the scepter holds the Mind Stone, later in Vision's forehead.
questions.note: Loki uses the scepter to control Hawkeye and Selvig; named in Age of Ultron.

questions.q: What is the name of the cassette Peter Quill keeps from his mother?
questions.why: His mother made it for him; he plays it on his Walkman.
questions.note: Morag opening and the prison scene.

questions.q: What gives each Black Panther their powers?
questions.why: Wakandans drink a potion made from the heart-shaped herb.
questions.note: Coronation and the ancestral plane scenes.

questions.q: What is the name of T'Challa's younger sister?
questions.why: Shuri runs Wakanda's science lab and builds the Panther suits.

questions.q: On what planet does Thor fight the Hulk in an arena?
questions.why: Thor lands on the trash planet Sakaar and is forced into the Contest of Champions.

questions.q: Who rules Sakaar?
questions.why: The Grandmaster runs the Contest of Champions.

questions.q: What is Captain Marvel's real name?
questions.why: Carol Danvers was a US Air Force pilot before she got her powers.

questions.q: Who is the villain in Spider-Man: Homecoming?
questions.why: Toomes builds the Vulture wings from salvaged Chitauri tech.

questions.q: Who does Thanos sacrifice on Vormir to get the Soul Stone?
questions.why: The Soul Stone demands "a soul for a soul", someone he loves.

questions.q: How long after the Snap does Avengers: Endgame jump ahead?
questions.why: The title card reads "Five years later".
questions.note: Title card after the Thanos farm scene.

questions.q: What is the name of Tony Stark's daughter?
questions.why: Tony and Pepper's daughter Morgan says she loves him "3000".

questions.q: Who says "Avengers... assemble" in the final battle of Endgame?
questions.why: Steve says it as every hero arrives through the portals.

questions.q: Who directed Avengers: Endgame?
questions.why: The Russo brothers directed Winter Soldier, Civil War, Infinity War and Endgame.

questions.q: What terrorist group holds Tony Stark captive in Iron Man (2008)?
questions.why: The Ten Rings' symbol is on the banner in the cave; the group returns in Shang-Chi (2021).

questions.q: What does Pepper have printed on the case she makes for Tony's first arc reactor?
questions.a: "Proof that Tony Stark has a heart"
questions.why: Tony later uses this old reactor to survive Stane's attack.

questions.q: Who is the actor hired to play the Mandarin in Iron Man 3?
questions.why: The Mandarin is a front: an actor named Trevor Slattery.
questions.note: Tony finds Trevor in the Miami mansion.

questions.q: Who is the real villain behind the Mandarin in Iron Man 3?
questions.why: Killian of A.I.M. invented the Mandarin as a cover.
questions.note: Killian reveals it at the mansion.

questions.q: What is the name of the program that makes people heat up and regenerate in Iron Man 3?
questions.why: Maya Hansen and Killian's Extremis treatment.

questions.q: After waking up in a fake 1940s room, where does Steve Rogers run out into?
questions.why: He runs into modern Times Square, where Nick Fury meets him.

questions.q: Which Avenger calls Loki a "puny god"?
questions.why: Hulk slams Loki into the floor of Stark Tower.
questions.note: Stark Tower, battle of New York.

questions.q: What food do the Avengers eat in The Avengers (2012) post-credits scene?
questions.why: Tony suggests it after the battle; the scene is after the full credits.

questions.q: In Age of Ultron, which country's city does Ultron lift into the sky?
questions.why: Ultron raises the Sokovian capital to drop it like a meteor.

questions.q: What are the laws to put the Avengers under UN control called in Civil War?
questions.why: Named after the damage in Sokovia.

questions.q: What relic does Doctor Strange wear that holds the Time Stone?
wrong: The Staff of the Living Tribunal
questions.why: The Eye of Agamotto is the amulet holding the Time Stone.
questions.note: Kamar-Taj library and the Dormammu scene.

questions.q: Who is Peter Quill's father in Guardians Vol. 2?
questions.why: Ego is a Celestial; Yondu is the one who raised him.

questions.q: Who beats T'Challa at Warrior Falls and takes the throne?
questions.why: Killmonger wins the ritual combat and throws T'Challa over the falls.

questions.q: What is Thanos's home planet?
questions.why: The Avengers fight Thanos on the ruins of Titan.

questions.q: Where is Thor's new axe Stormbreaker forged?
questions.why: Eitri the dwarf forges it at Nidavellir's star-powered forge.

questions.q: What is the name of Thor's new axe in Infinity War?
questions.why: Stormbreaker can summon the Bifrost.

questions.q: What scratches out Nick Fury's eye?
questions.why: Captain Marvel (2019) reveals Goose, a Flerken that looks like a cat, scratched him.

questions.q: What is Mysterio's real name?
questions.why: Beck is a former Stark Industries employee who fakes being a hero.
questions.note: Beck reveals his team in the bar.

questions.q: What weapon set gives Wenwu his power and long life?
questions.why: Wenwu has worn the Ten Rings for about a thousand years.

questions.q: Who sacrifices herself on Vormir in Avengers: Endgame?
questions.why: Natasha lets go so Clint can bring back the Soul Stone.

questions.q: In the Iron Man (2008) post-credits scene, what does Nick Fury say he wants to talk to Tony about?
questions.why: Fury's first appearance: "I'm here to talk to you about the Avenger Initiative."

questions.q: What is the name of the New Mexico town where Thor lands in Thor (2011)?
questions.why: Puente Antiguo is the made-up desert town where Jane Foster works.
questions.note: Thor hits Jane's van; diner scenes.

questions.q: What does Tony build in his workshop to create a new element in Iron Man 2?
questions.why: He uses his father's Stark Expo model as the plan.

questions.q: What is the name of the boy who helps Tony in Tennessee in Iron Man 3?
questions.why: Harley appears again at Tony's funeral in Endgame.

questions.q: What birth year is shown for Steve Rogers on the Smithsonian exhibit?
questions.why: The Smithsonian Captain America exhibit lists his birth year as 1918.

questions.q: What is the name of Thanos's servant who talks to Loki in The Avengers (2012)?
questions.why: The Other warns Loki about failing Thanos.

questions.q: What soundtrack does Sam Wilson tell Steve to add to his catch-up list?
wrong: What's Going On by Marvin Gaye
questions.why: Steve writes "Trouble Man soundtrack" in his notebook.
questions.note: Sam and Steve meet in DC; notebook shot.

questions.q: Whose algorithm picks Project Insight's targets in The Winter Soldier?
questions.why: Zola's mind lives on in a computer at Camp Lehigh and explains his algorithm.

questions.q: What is the name of Peter Quill's mother?
questions.why: Meredith Quill dies in 1988 at the start of the film.

questions.q: What is Yondu's whistle-controlled weapon called?
questions.why: Yondu steers the Yaka arrow with whistles; his fin controls it.
questions.note: Yondu's escape from the Ravager ship.

questions.q: Who lifts Mjolnir and hands it to Thor in Age of Ultron?
questions.why: Proof Vision is "worthy", shocking the Avengers.

questions.q: How many possible futures does Doctor Strange look at in Infinity War?
questions.why: He says they won in only one.

questions.q: About how old does Thor tell Rocket he is in Infinity War?
questions.why: Thor: "I'm 1500 years old."

questions.q: In what year is Captain Marvel (2019) set?
questions.why: It's set in the 1990s, before the other Avengers films.

questions.q: What store does Carol Danvers crash into when she lands on Earth?
questions.why: She falls through the roof of a Blockbuster in Los Angeles.

questions.q: What name do the Kree call Carol Danvers?
questions.why: The Kree gave her the name Vers after taking her memory.

questions.q: In Endgame, what year do Tony and Steve go to at Camp Lehigh for the Tesseract and Pym Particles?
questions.why: Tony meets his father Howard there.

questions.q: In Endgame, what year in Asgard do Thor and Rocket visit for the Reality Stone?
questions.why: They take the Aether from Jane Foster in 2013.

questions.q: Which Infinity Stone do Rhodey and Nebula get on Morag in 2014?
questions.why: Morag is where Quill finds the Orb in Guardians of the Galaxy.

questions.q: Which Infinity Stone does Bruce get from the Ancient One in 2012?
questions.why: He promises to return it.
